name: Hornero Studio Audio
description: Audio Extensions 2.0: bar indicator, popover and dashboard card for the Studio audio mode and Temporary Performance state from the typed horneroctl contract. Read-only; mode changes stay in the CLI and Control Center.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Bar indicator is a single short line.
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: Hornero Glyph mode icons, segmented output meter and instrument module header.
Popover actions use the native full-width UiActionRow (shell 1.2.79 PluginKit) instead of small buttons.
Suppress the indicator tooltip while its popover is open (it floated over the popover and covered the Output row).

Native popout: subtitle header, caption state line and label/value detail rows (PluginKit UiDetailRow), no hero metrics or outlined chip. Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.74 (UiText subtitle, UiDetailRow, borderless UiPopover).
Bar indicator joins the native status icons island (section status), next to volume and microphone. Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.73 (bar sections).

Native look: card header, one native icon per studio mode in the bar (filled while Temporary Performance is on), shorter read-only note, Refresh with icon. Needs Hornero Shell 1.2.72 (PluginKit UiIcon/iconName/card header).

Audio Extensions 2.0: compact indicator with host-owned popover and dashboard card (mode, Temporary Performance, read-only output state, refresh), typed refreshSeconds/showWhenUnavailable settings, Theme tokens, host-context layout and Spanish catalog. Still read-only over the typed horneroctl studio contract.
Bar indicator for the Studio audio mode and Temporary Performance state; stacked caption so the mode code does not clip in the bar.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between studio mode refreshes from horneroctl.

showWhenUnavailable.description: Keep the bar indicator visible, labelled as unavailable, when horneroctl returns no usable studio mode.
